svg.title: Design Services — BPMN teaching model
svg.desc: BPMN collaboration with a customer and Charles River Sales, Design Team, Customer Accounting, and Treasury lanes. Approved billable hours proceed to invoice and cash application; non-billable hours retain cost support without customer billing.

div.div:
Both billable and non-billable approved hours carry analytical cost support; only billable hours enter the billing rollup. Payroll remains its own expense cycle.
Role allocation is illustrative. Proposed teaching control: compare assignments, approval evidence, billed hours and invoice links; do not infer full engagement profit from labor margin.
